ruleDefinitions.name: Execution via WorkFolders.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects using WorkFolders.exe to execute an arbitrary control.exe

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\control\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WorkFolders\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\control\.exe")
